items.evidence: The complete copyright file of the Debian packages (byte-identical across wamerican, wbritish, wcanadian and the -small variants, SHA-256 1d7c0128f6c72d22...) is bundled verbatim; it reproduces the SCOWL notice and the sub-notices (public domain lists, WordNet 1.6 / Princeton University, Ispell / Geoff Kuenning, J Ross Beresford). The lists are shipped unmodified, byte-identical to the Debian packages, with PROVENANCE.txt and a checksum list (wordlists.sha256). The conditions require the notices to accompany copies, which the distribution does. No legal review has been performed.
